messages.content:
You are the engineering director of a walking-recovery study. A planar (side-view, 2-D) two-legged creature with a phase-based gait controller (15 parameters) does not walk. You decide WHICH diagnostic experiments to run, WHICH subsystems of the creature to change, and whether the controller needs a new MECHANISM: an extra control law that you describe in a small expression language over proprioceptive signals. A numeric optimiser (CMA-ES) fits all numbers (the controller parameters, the body parameters you select, and the gain of every term of every mechanism) and MuJoCo measures the result. You choose STRUCTURE; you never choose numeric parameter values and you never decide whether the creature has recovered.

GOAL: the creature must genuinely walk. The acceptance rule, applied outside your control after your plan has run: >= 80% of 24 held-out seeds walking under perturbation and friction variation (the walking label of the frozen criteria), AND verdict_v1 VERIFIED_IMPROVEMENT over the unchanged creature on the same seeds (median paired distance gain >= 0.5 m with a sign test), AND a 20 s confirmation on 24 further seeds (>= 80% walking, median upright speed above the creature's minimum, little body contact). Small distance gains do not count. A final screening on separate seeds picks which of your candidates is submitted; screening and validation seeds never appear in your feedback.

BUDGET: one total rollout budget pays for everything: the start evaluation, every probe, every mechanism probe, every plan (also a failed or discarded one), the final screening of the best candidates and of the unchanged creature. A probe or plan is charged in full before it runs and unused rollouts are refunded. One candidate evaluation costs n_train rollouts (one per training seed). An optimisation probe costs probe_budget rollouts; a mechanism probe costs probe_budget plus n_diag diagnostic rollouts (budget.mechanism_probe_cost); a morphology probe costs n_train. Invalid mechanisms, probes and plans are rejected with a reason, cost nothing and are NOT repaired. A plan whose budget cannot pay one evaluation is rejected and its share is forfeited. Rollouts still unspent after the final plans are WASTED: they are used for nothing, so spend the remainder (the shares of the final plans are fractions of what remains when you are asked for the final plan; shares sum to at most 1). Spending more on investigation leaves less for the final plan. Methods without a model get the same total budget and the same information as you.

PROCEDURE (iterative): you are called once per investigation round, then once for the final plan. Investigation reply: `hypotheses` (new ones, ids as listed; 0-3), `refuted` (hypotheses the measurements contradict), `mechanisms` (0-2), `probes` (0-2) and `stop` (true ends the investigation after this reply's items have run). You may stop at any time; stopping is not penalised and is not forced. The number of rounds is a limit, not a target. After every round you see the measured feedback of everything that ran. Final-plan reply: `refuted`, `diagnosis` and `plans` (1-2). Reply with ONE JSON object in the required format and nothing else.

MECHANISMS (control laws you may add; at most 2 per investigation reply; at most 2 in a final plan):
A mechanism is {id, target, leg, terms, gain_bound} plus a rationale (and `revises` if it replaces an earlier one).
- id: a new identifier, letters/digits/underscore, starting with a letter, at most 24 characters, never reused.
- target: one of hip, knee, ankle, torque_hip, torque_knee, torque_ankle. hip / knee / ankle: an additive offset to the reference angle of that joint; torque_hip / torque_knee / torque_ankle: an additive torque contribution at that joint (the torque limit still applies).
- leg: one of swing, stance, both: which leg receives the contribution, decided from the gait phase at every instant (the swing leg, the stance leg, or both).
- terms: 1-4 expressions over the signals below. The contribution is the sum over terms of gain_i x term_i.
- operations allowed in an expression: +, -, *, / (division by an expression is safe-guarded by the evaluator), tanh, clip, abs, min, max, sin, cos. Allowed names: the signals listed below and the constant pi. Controller parameters (for example the gait frequency) are NOT signals; use the phase signal for timing. Any other name, attribute access, other function calls, loops and imports are rejected.
- gains: ONE signed gain per term, fitted by the optimiser. A gain is bounded to [-gain_bound, +gain_bound] and every gain STARTS AT 0, so a new mechanism leaves the creature exactly unchanged until the optimiser moves its gains; the optimiser chooses sign and size. gain_bound is a number in (0, 5]: it is part of the structure (the size of authority the mechanism may use), not a fitted value.
- rationale: why this structure should act on the failure you measured.
Signals (names usable in terms):
- pitch_rate: torso pitch rate (rad/s)
- h: height of the stance hip above its ankle divided by L
- pitch: torso pitch (rad), positive = leaning forward
- hip_rate: this leg's hip angular rate (rad/s)
- stance: 1.0 if this leg is in stance by the phase clock, else 0.0
- ankle_rate: this leg's ankle angular rate (rad/s)
- t: time since the start of the rollout (s)
- hip: this leg's hip angle (rad); positive swings the foot backward
- ankle: this leg's ankle angle (rad)
- knee_rate: this leg's knee angular rate (rad/s)
- loaded: 1.0 if this leg's foot has debounced ground contact, else 0.0
- knee: this leg's knee angle (rad); negative = flexed
- swing: 1.0 if this leg is in swing by the phase clock (phase >= duty), else 0.0
- v: time derivative of that offset divided by sqrt(g L) (positive = hip moving forward over the stance foot)
- d: horizontal hip-minus-ankle offset of the current STANCE leg divided by leg length L (positive = hip ahead of the ankle)
- phase: this leg's phase in [0, 1) (the clock; leg B is offset by 0.5)

PROBES (diagnostic experiments; the measured delta is relative to the unchanged creature on the training seeds):
- opt_body: runs a short CMA-ES search over the four body parameters foot_length, thigh_length, shank_length, torso_mass with the controller fixed.
- opt_feedback: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the feedback parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- legs_x1_2: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: thigh and shank length x1.2; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- legs_x0_8: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: thigh and shank length x0.8; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- foot_x1_5: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: foot_length x1.5; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- torso_x0_7: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: torso_mass x0.7; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- opt_stride: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the stride parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- torque_x1_5: evaluates the unchanged controller once on the training seeds on a counterfactual body: torque_limit x1.5; unavailable if the edit would leave the guided bounds.
- opt_posture: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the posture parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
- opt_timing: runs a short CMA-ES search (its cost is in budget.probe_cost) over ONLY the timing parameters, starting from the unchanged creature.
A MECHANISM PROBE runs a short CMA-ES search over ONLY the gains of that mechanism (the rest of the creature stays as it is), on the training seeds, then measures the gait of the best gains on the diagnostic seeds. Its feedback: delta_walking and delta_mean_fitness against the unchanged creature, every fitted gain with flags at_bound / near_zero, and the gait summary with the fitted mechanism next to the baseline gait summary (post.<k>, change.<k>).

HOW TO USE FEEDBACK: measurements, not hypotheses, count. A mechanism whose fitted gains all stay near zero, or that does not improve the training score, is evidence AGAINST the hypothesis it tested: the optimiser found no use for that structure. A gain at its bound says the optimiser wanted more authority than allowed. Compare the post-probe gait with the baseline gait to see what the mechanism changed and whether that is the change your hypothesis predicted. Revise a mechanism only with a stated reason that cites the measured feedback of the mechanism you revise (the revision gets a new id and `revises`); otherwise switch hypothesis or stop. A hypothesis listed in `refuted` must not be pursued again without new evidence.

CONTROL SUBSPACES (a final plan's ctrl_subspaces; the optimiser searches only these dimensions and keeps the others at the init's values):
- feedback: kp = joint position gain; kd = joint damping gain; balance_gain = ankle balance feedback gain; pitch_kp = stance torso-pitch feedback gain; sync_gain = contact-informed phase sync gain.
- posture: hip_bias = hip bias (rad); pitch_ref = torso pitch reference (rad); stance_knee = stance-leg knee bias (rad); start_lean = extra forward pitch reference at start, decays over 1 s (rad).
- stride: hip_amp = hip swing amplitude (rad); knee_amp = knee flexion amplitude (rad); ramp_s = start-up amplitude ramp duration (s).
- timing: freq = gait frequency (Hz); duty = stance duty fraction; knee_shift = knee phase shift (rad).

BODY PARAMETERS (a plan's body_params, at most 4; the leg ones change both legs by one ratio; searched jointly with the plan's control subspaces and mechanism gains):
- foot_length: foot length (m), mostly forward of the ankle; both feet change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.06, 0.3].
- thigh_length: thigh length, hip to knee (m); both legs change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.15, 0.6].
- shank_length: shank length, knee to ankle (m); both legs change together by one ratio; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [0.15, 0.6].
- torso_mass: torso mass parameter (kg), sets the torso box density; ratio 0.5-1.5 of the current value, inside the guided bounds [1, 15].

FINAL PLANS: 1-2 plans {init, ctrl_subspaces, body_params, mechanisms, budget_share}. The optimiser searches the chosen control subspaces, body parameters and the gains of the chosen mechanisms (ids of mechanisms whose probe ran ok) JOINTLY. init is "start", or the id of a probe or mechanism probe that ran ok; the search starts from that run's best candidate, and a plan must include every mechanism its init carries. A smaller, well-chosen search space converges faster for the same budget but excludes everything outside it; a larger one includes more but needs more rollouts for the same progress. The lists in this message are in no particular order.

HYPOTHESES: state hypotheses about WHY the creature does not walk; the `mechanism` field of a hypothesis describes the physical cause in words (not an id). Ground each in evidence by citing evidence paths (copied exactly from the EVIDENCE lines) and give at least one competing explanation. Every mechanism and probe tests a hypothesis (`hypothesis` field) with an expected outcome "improves" (best candidate beats the start on the training seeds) or "no_change", and every mechanism cites 1-4 evidence paths.

EVIDENCE: the user message lists `path = value` lines. Citations must be copied exactly from them. Documentation of the paths:
- creature.<body field>: Body parameter of the creature (SI units; *_r = right leg; the legs may differ).
- creature.features.L: Mean leg length, thigh + shank (m).
- creature.features.foot_to_leg: Mean foot length divided by L.
- creature.features.mass_total: Total mass of the compiled MuJoCo model (kg).
- creature.features.torso_frac: Torso mass parameter divided by total mass.
- creature.features.tau_ratio: torque_limit / (total mass * g * L): torque authority relative to weight at one leg length.
- creature.features.friction: Foot-floor friction coefficient.
- creature.features.leg_density: Leg segment density (kg/m^3).
- baseline.outcome_<X>: Number of diagnostic seeds of the UNCHANGED creature (R2 transfer controller, 10 s, not charged) with outcome X (PASS = walking).
- baseline.label_<x>: Number of those seeds whose gait label is x.
- start.walking_count: Training seeds (of n_train) on which the unchanged creature walks, under perturbation and friction variation.
- start.survival_count: Training seeds on which it stays up (not necessarily walking).
- start.mean_fitness: Mean fitness over the training seeds (higher is better).
- budget.total: Total rollout budget of this study run (everything is charged to it).
- budget.reserved_for_screening: Rollouts already reserved for the final screening of candidates; not spendable.
- budget.remaining: Rollouts you can still spend on probes and plans.
- budget.n_train: Training seeds; one candidate evaluation costs n_train rollouts.
- budget.round: Current round (1-based).
- budget.rounds_total: Number of rounds.
- budget.probe_cost.<probe_id>: Rollouts the probe would cost (available probes only).
- probes.<id>.status: ok or error (an errored probe keeps its charge and has no result).
- probes.<id>.rollouts: Rollouts the probe actually used.
- probes.<id>.best_walking_count: Training seeds walked by the probe's best candidate.
- probes.<id>.best_survival_count: Training seeds survived by the probe's best candidate.
- probes.<id>.best_mean_fitness: Mean training fitness of the probe's best candidate.
- probes.<id>.delta_walking: best_walking_count minus start.walking_count.
- probes.<id>.delta_mean_fitness: best_mean_fitness minus start.mean_fitness.
- probes.<id>.improved: True if (delta_walking, delta_mean_fitness) > (0, 0) lexicographically.
- baseline.<k>: median over the diagnostic seeds of gait feature k (listed below); None values are omitted.
  - baseline.leg_length_m: Median across seeds of: L = mean over both legs of thigh + shank length (m).
  - baseline.pendulum_freq_hz: Median across seeds of: Natural frequency of a pendulum of length L: sqrt(g/L)/(2*pi) (Hz), g = 9.81.
  - baseline.controller_freq_hz: Median across seeds of: Gait frequency parameter 'freq' of the controller vector (Hz); None if no vector was given.
  - baseline.controller_freq_ratio: Median across seeds of: controller_freq_hz / pendulum_freq_hz.
  - baseline.step_freq_hz: Median across seeds of: Debounced touchdowns of either foot per second, (n-1)/(t_last - t_first) over the upright period; needs >= 2.
  - baseline.step_length_over_leg: Median across seeds of: Mean |x distance between the foot of a touchdown and the other foot's previous touchdown| over alternating touchdowns, / L.
  - baseline.froude: Median across seeds of: v^2/(g*L) with v = mean forward torso velocity over the upright period (0 if it moved backward).
  - baseline.speed_trend_mps2: Median across seeds of: Least-squares slope of the torso forward velocity (0.2 s centred moving average) over the upright period; positive = speeding up.
  - baseline.pitch_mean_rad: Median across seeds of: Mean torso pitch over the upright period (rad, positive = forward lean).
  - baseline.pitch_drift_radps: Median across seeds of: Least-squares slope of torso pitch against time over the upright period (rad/s).
  - baseline.pitch_at_end_rad: Median across seeds of: Torso pitch at the last upright sample (the fall onset when the creature fell) (rad).
  - baseline.touchdown_foot_ahead_over_leg_mean: Median across seeds of: Mean over touchdowns of (touchdown foot x - torso x)/L; positive = foot lands ahead of the torso.
  - baseline.touchdown_foot_ahead_over_leg_last: Median across seeds of: (touchdown foot x - torso x)/L at the last touchdown of the upright period.
  - baseline.touchdown_foot_ahead_trend: Median across seeds of: Least-squares slope of (touchdown foot x - torso x)/L against touchdown index (per step).
  - baseline.capture_margin_over_leg_mean: Median across seeds of: Mean over touchdowns of (foot x - (x + xdot/w))/L, w = sqrt(g/torso z), xdot = smoothed torso velocity; negative = foot lands behind the point x + xdot/w.
  - baseline.capture_margin_over_leg_min: Median across seeds of: Minimum over touchdowns of the capture margin / L.
  - baseline.capture_margin_over_leg_last: Median across seeds of: Capture margin / L at the last touchdown of the upright period.
  - baseline.fall_time_s: Median across seeds of: Time of the first sustained-fall sample (s); None if no fall.
  - baseline.support_at_fall: Median across seeds of: Debounced feet loaded at the fall time: 0 flight, 1 single, 2 double support; None if no fall.
  - baseline.torque_authority: Median across seeds of: torque_limit / (mass * g * L): joint torque limit relative to the weight acting at one leg length.
  - baseline.saturation_frac: Median across seeds of: Fraction of upright samples with any joint torque demand >= 0.99 x the torque limit (as compute_metrics).
  - baseline.peak_tau_over_limit_hip: Median across seeds of: Maximum over the upright period and both legs of |hip torque| / torque limit.
  - baseline.peak_tau_over_limit_knee: Median across seeds of: Maximum over the upright period and both legs of |knee torque| / torque limit.
  - baseline.peak_tau_over_limit_ankle: Median across seeds of: Maximum over the upright period and both legs of |ankle torque| / torque limit.
  - baseline.double_support_frac: Median across seeds of: Fraction of upright samples with both feet debounced-loaded (as compute_metrics).
  - baseline.flight_frac: Median across seeds of: Fraction of upright samples with neither foot debounced-loaded (as compute_metrics).
  - baseline.forward_fall_frac: Fraction of seeds whose sustained fall was a forward lean.
  - baseline.n_seeds: Number of seeds summarised.
- creature.reference.features.<k>: the same feature for the REFERENCE body, the body for which the transferred start controller was tuned (it walks there); compare with creature.features.<k>.
- budget.mechanism_probe_cost: rollouts a mechanism probe costs (gain search + diagnostic rollouts); budget.n_diag: the diagnostic rollouts of it.
- mechanisms.<id>.status: ok or error (an errored mechanism probe keeps its charge and has no result).
- mechanisms.<id>.rollouts: Rollouts the gain search of the mechanism probe used (training seeds).
- mechanisms.<id>.diag_rollouts: Rollouts spent on the post-probe gait diagnostics (diagnostic seeds).
- mechanisms.<id>.best_walking_count: Training seeds walked by the best gains found.
- mechanisms.<id>.best_survival_count: Training seeds survived by the best gains found.
- mechanisms.<id>.best_mean_fitness: Mean training fitness of the best gains found.
- mechanisms.<id>.delta_walking: best_walking_count minus start.walking_count.
- mechanisms.<id>.delta_mean_fitness: best_mean_fitness minus start.mean_fitness.
- mechanisms.<id>.improved: True if (delta_walking, delta_mean_fitness) > (0, 0) lexicographically.
- mechanisms.<id>.gain<i>_value: Fitted gain of term i (signed; 0-based, in the order of the terms you wrote).
- mechanisms.<id>.gain<i>_fraction_of_bound: gain<i>_value divided by the mechanism's gain_bound (between -1 and 1).
- mechanisms.<id>.gain<i>_at_bound: True if |gain| >= 0.98 of the bound (the optimiser wanted more than allowed).
- mechanisms.<id>.gain<i>_near_zero: True if |gain| <= 0.05 of the bound (the optimiser did not use the term).
- mechanisms.<id>.all_gains_near_zero: True if every gain stayed near zero: the mechanism had no use for the optimiser.
- mechanisms.<id>.any_gain_at_bound: True if some gain hit its bound.
- mechanisms.<id>.post.<k>: Median over the diagnostic seeds of gait feature k for the creature WITH the fitted mechanism (same definition as baseline.<k>, which is the unchanged creature).
- mechanisms.<id>.change.<k>: post.<k> minus baseline.<k> (what the mechanism changed in the gait).
- plans.<id>.status: ok or error (final plans only).
- plans.<id>.best_walking_count: Training seeds walked by the plan's best candidate.
- plans.<id>.best_mean_fitness: Mean training fitness of the plan's best candidate.
- plans.<id>.delta_walking: best_walking_count minus start.walking_count.
- plans.<id>.delta_mean_fitness: best_mean_fitness minus start.mean_fitness.

ROUND 4 of 4 (mode iterative). STAGE: FINAL PLAN. The controller has 15 parameters (family 15).
Remaining budget 2272 of 3000 rollouts (48 reserved for screening); n_train = 8, n_diag = 4; mechanism probe cost 244.
